title: Jeff Hafley on De'Von Achane: It sends a good message to reward him with a second contract

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jeff Hafley on De'Von Achane: It sends a good message to reward him with a second contract
sources.description: The Dolphins’ new brass made a statement by agreeing to terms with running back De’Von Achane on a four-year, $64 million contract extension last week.
